title: Hush Harbor · Part 2
idea: Nobody voted, so the fox chose THROW: under the deck the red eye is two steps from the music; you take the box from the smiling girl, run across the metal deck in your socks and grab the railing (it's warm, like skin); the box spins into the fog still playing, something huge rolls after it and the music sinks. Silence. At 3:41 the engines start, the captain thanks the passengers. The mother wakes up and you tell her her little girl is safe: 'I don't have a daughter.' The seat is empty, wet little footprints lead to the railing, and the fox lifts her lantern in the fog. So who did you just save?
hook: Nobody chose, so the fox chose for you. Throw it. Under the floor, the red eye is two steps from the music.
caption:
Part 2. Nobody dared to choose, so the fox chose for you: THROW. 🦊🏮
You grabbed the railing. It was warm. Like skin.
The music box sank into the fog, and the thing under the ferry went after it. 🌫️

Then the mother woke up: "I don't have a daughter."
Wet little footprints, all the way to the railing. 👣

So who did you just save? Tell me in the comments 👇
first_comment: Who was the little girl? 👣 Best theory gets pinned 🦊🏮
